assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game-interface border, a single reusable nine-slice panel frame for a drowned coastal shrine fantasy roleplaying app. Create one square image, front-facing orthographic. The background, both the large rectangular central opening and the space outside the frame, is perfectly flat pure magenta #FF00FF with no shading, no gradient and no shadows cast onto it (it will be keyed out to transparency). The frame is made from richly hand-painted weathered pale silvery driftwood rails, sea-worn and smooth, with dark green-brown kelp ribbons physically wrapping the rails near the corners and small clusters of pale barnacles and tiny limpets at the four corners. Each corner joint is held by an aged bronze clasp with blue-green verdigris patina and small rivets, with a single tiny pearl inlay. Material depth, visible wood grain, soft dimensional highlights: the tactile artistic UI craft of a classic fantasy strategy game, not a flat vector border. Frame aligned square to the canvas, no perspective. Each driftwood rail stays narrow, within the outer 12 percent of the image; corner clusters can fill the outer 18 percent. Keep the middle stretches of all four rails simple, straight and continuous so they can stretch in a responsive UI. The central 64 percent in each dimension must be entirely flat magenta and empty, no kelp, texture or ornaments crossing it. Frame nearly fills the canvas with a 3 percent flat magenta outer margin; all kelp and barnacles fully inside the image, nothing cropped. Soft neutral top-left light; pale grey-tan driftwood, verdigris teal bronze, deep olive kelp, pearl white. Do not use magenta, pink or purple anywhere in the frame itself. No words, no letters, no buttons, no icons, no creatures, no fish, no scenery, no watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production seamless material texture for the panels and buttons of a sunken coastal shrine fantasy game UI. A square, edge-to-edge close-up of weathered pale driftwood planking. Straight-on orthographic surface, no perspective, no objects, no border or frame. Rich hand-painted game-art material with tangible shallow sea-worn grain, long gently flowing horizontal fibers, a few small smooth knots, silvery grey-beige sun-bleached wood with faint cool sea-glass teal staining in the pores and a trace of dried salt. Color and contrast restrained enough to sit beneath readable UI text: mid-tone pale grey-tan, no bright white highlights, no black holes, no large cracks, no gaps between planks. Seamless repeating tile in both axes, no vignette, no directional lighting gradients, no letters, no emblems, no shells, no barnacles, no metal, no scenery, no watermark. Output 1024 square.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One production fantasy game interface corner fitting, square image, front-facing orthographic. Rails taper naturally toward the right edge and bottom edge, ending within the canvas with a small magenta margin, so this can sit over continuous rails. No right or bottom border. Do not use magenta, pink or purple anywhere in the fitting itself. No scenery, no text, no symbols, no creatures, no frame around the entire image, no shadow on the background.
